reviews.author: Mark Vu
reviews.text: I went for a sport massage with Lizt team. The staff was very knowledgeable and knew which area he should focus on. The pressure applied was just right. Highly recommend for any athletes or anyone who is active in sports.

reviews.author: Meirav Caspi
reviews.text: I've been to many therapists in my life, but she was by far the best I've ever seen. I came in with a twisted ankle, injuries in both knees, and a tight back, and I left walking straight with much less pain. Highly recommend her to everyone!

reviews.author: Tam Phan Thi Thanh
reviews.text: Incredible experience at Stretch! Liz is a phenomenal therapist—she really knows how to work through the tension and leave you feeling completely refreshed. If you're looking for professional sports recovery, this is the place to be.
